senses.definition: A gambling game, a variety of lotto, played with balls or knobs, numbered, and cards also numbered.

quotes.text: Memories of this night are extremely hazy. All I have, for guide-pegs, is a pocketful of keno cards and cocktail napkins, all covered with scribbled notes.
quotes.reference: 1971, Hunter S. Thompson, Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas, Harper Perennial, published 2005, page 41:
